step1_analysis.description: A passive RC network used to provide a frequency-dependent attenuation. In the context of the paper, it is likely used as a reference filter or attenuator in the adaptive Q-tuning scheme for the OTA-based bandpass filter.

paper_reference.title: An Enhanced Adaptive Q-Tuning Scheme for a 100-MHz Fully Symmetric OTA-Based Bandpass Filter

dc_gain.description: Low frequency voltage gain of the passive network

sky130_expected.calculation: At DC, capacitors are open. Gain is determined by R1 and R2. Assuming R1=R2=R, Gain = R1/(R1+R2) = 0.5. In dB: 20*log10(0.5) = -6.02 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined purely by the resistor divider ratio, independent of technology.

hf_gain.description: High frequency voltage gain of the passive network

sky130_expected.calculation: At high frequencies, capacitors dominate. Gain = C2/(C1+C2) = (Cp/(Q-1)) / (Cp + Cp/(Q-1)) = 1/Q. For Q=5, Gain = 0.2. In dB: 20*log10(0.2) = -13.98 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the capacitor divider ratio, which depends on the quality factor parameter Q.

mid_freq.description: Frequency at which the gain is halfway between DC and HF gain in dB

sky130_expected.calculation: Geometric mean of pole and zero frequencies. For R=1k, Cp=2.5p, Q=5, f_mid is approximately 160 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on chosen R and C values. Scaled to match the 160 MHz frequency reported in the paper's context.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the DC gain, high-frequency gain, and the midpoint frequency of the passive RC network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Passive RC Lead-Lag Filter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Define parameters based on expected values
.param R=1k
.param Cp=2.5p
.param Q=5

* DUT (Syntax corrected from extracted netlist to be valid SPICE)
R2 Vi Vo {R}
C2 Vi Vo {Cp/(Q-1)}
R1 Vo GND {R}
C1 Vo GND {Cp}

* Stimulus
Vin Vi GND dc 1 ac 1

* Control block
.control
* Run AC analysis from 1 Hz to 10 GHz
ac dec 100 1 10G

* Calculate gain in dB
let gain_db = vdb(Vo)

* Measure DC gain at 10 Hz
meas ac dc_gain_db find gain_db at=10

* Measure High Frequency gain at 10 GHz
meas ac hf_gain_db find gain_db at=10G

* Calculate midpoint gain and find corresponding frequency
let mid_gain = (dc_gain_db + hf_gain_db) / 2
meas ac f_mid when gain_db=mid_gain

* Print results
print dc_gain_db hf_gain_db f_mid

quit
.endc
.end
